name: Calendula
summary: Soft, warm business banking for a bakery with three shops, with a what-if cash forecast
about: A complete business banking app in soft cream (or cocoa) with warm orange highlights, filled with sample data for a bakery with three shops and a central kitchen. Each shop banks into its own account, staff carry freezable cards with limits, and supplier bills feed a 90-day cash forecast. Flip on what-ifs like an Eid rush or a fourth shop and watch the forecast line, its range and the safe-to-spend number change.
how: Hover the forecast to read any day; switch 30, 60 or 90 days
Turn what-if scenarios on and off, or drag daily sales up and down, and watch the line morph
Move money between accounts or pay a supplier with a review and confirm step
Sweep spare shop cash to Main, open a new pot, or download a statement
Freeze a staff card, change its limits, or issue a new one
Pay, edit or add bills; the forecast picks them up straight away
